issues.description: Element: output column for Aufgabe 10. The problem statement (problem_statement.md line 61) explicitly asks for the IDs of all Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe10.sql line 1) selects Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name instead of an ID column. This contradicts the requirement and will cause students' correct ID-based queries to disagree with the solution, producing inconsistent grading/results.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution to select the Radweg ID column rather than the name. Example correction: SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id FROM Radweg_zu_Gemeinde, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Oberfranken' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk = 'Unterfranken'); Ensure the chosen column name matches the actual schema (e.g. radweg_id or radweg_schluessel). Do not use DISTINCT so duplicates are preserved as required by the problem statement.
